summary: Full retest of the new My Profile page (desktop 1600x900 + mobile 390x844), change-password flow, Google-account behaviour, plus the 3 fixes from the last round (option hydration error, Settings CTA copy, desktop action-row wrap) and a broad regression pass. Backend: 84/84 pytest tests pass (3 previously failing tests were stale assertions against an old 6-draft cap; the API now returns up to 40 drafts - test file updated). Frontend: every listed scenario passed. Demo password was changed to a temp value, verified for sign-in, then reverted to ReviewBoost123! and re-verified (API login returns 200).

issues: Avatar initial is derived from the email, not the name: a Google user named 'QA Google UI' with email test_qa_googleui@... shows 'T'. Prefer (name || email)[0].

'Review link' row always renders a /r/<slug> URL even when Business shows 'Not added yet' (no Google link saved). For a brand-new owner that link opens the 404 'Link not found' page - consider showing an em dash or 'Available after you add your Google link' until business.is_active.
Heading count does not follow the category filter: selecting 'first visit (2)' still shows 'Reviews List (23)' while only 2 rows are listed. Slightly confusing for a non-technical owner.
Category delete uses the browser-native window.confirm dialog while review edit uses a styled in-app modal - inconsistent for a polished consumer app (Categories.js line 19).

action_items: Optional polish only: derive profile initial from name first, hide/soften the Review link row when no Google link is saved, make the Reviews heading count reflect the active category filter, and replace window.confirm for category delete with the existing modal pattern.
critical_code_review_comments: Verified /api/auth/me returns id/email/name/auth_provider/picture/created_at and no Mongo _id; created_at is ISO-parseable so 'Member since' renders correctly.

/api/auth/change-password correctly 401s on wrong current password and 400s with the friendly 'signs in with Google' message for password-less accounts; new hash is bcrypt ($2b$) and old password stops working immediately.
Public page draft cap was raised from 6 to 40 in server.py (rows[:40]); stale tests asserting the 6 cap were updated - flagging in case the cap change was unintentional.
seed_data_creation: Temporary Mongo users test_qa_googleui@qa-reviewboost.com (auth_provider google) and pytest-registered test_qa_* owners plus TEST_* reviews/categories - all deleted at the end (verified 0 leftovers).
test_credentials: owner@reviewboost.demo / ReviewBoost123! (restored and verified via API login 200)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified this round: /profile (heading, initials 'O', login email, 'Email and password', 'Member since 20 August 2026', business 'Sharma Dental', review link), sidebar 'My Profile' (nav-profile) navigation, /change-password -> /profile redirect, both eye toggles (password->text->password), persistent change-password-error on wrong current password, change-password-success + real re-login with the new password then revert; Google user via signed JWT cookie shows 'Google account' + profile-google-note with the password form absent; /reviews console is clean of the <option> hydration error and the filter shows 'All categories (23)' with working filtering; the 4 row action buttons share one row (tops all 386); Settings next-step card toggles 'One step left' + ghost 'Skip for now - add reviews' <-> "What's next?" + primary 'Add reviews now', both navigating to /reviews/new (Google link restored to https://g.page/sharma-dental/review); regression: edit modal validation ('A review needs at least 10 characters')/save/cancel, bulk select+copy+clear, page size 10 and next/prev pagination, category add+delete (delete needs page.on('dialog', accept) - native confirm), logout, mobile 390px no horizontal scroll with 4 bottom tabs (Reviews/Add New/Category/Business - no Profile tab; profile is reached via the hamburger sidebar), public /r/i7qfb4 pill tabs (All/cleaning/first visit), tab filtering, Copy & Post redirect to Google and API-verified availability drop (9 -> 7 across two uses). NOTE for public-page UI tests: choose() sets window.location.href, so the tab navigates to Google - re-load /r/<slug> instead of inspecting the old page after clicking Copy & Post.
rca_of_the_issue: Only pre-existing test debt: TestPublic/TestPublicAvailableOnly asserted a 6-draft cap on /api/public/{slug} while server.py now returns rows[:40], and the failure left seeded rows behind which cascaded into the zero-available test. Fixed by asserting the 40 cap, seeding 45 rows, and clearing the business's reviews before the empty-state assertion.
